codeReview.summary: The replay API now returns explicit success/unbalanced results, but the range validator still misses an important class of structurally unbalanced subranges, so the feature does not fully satisfy VAL-SCENE-007.

issues.description: validateReplayRange() only scans scene.paintRecords[range], so it never accounts for scopes that were already open before range.lowerBound or still open after range.upperBound. A slice that lies entirely inside an outer scoped layer, or one that only balances an inner nested scope, is incorrectly reported as .success, and replay() then re-emits the enclosed primitives without their required startLayer/endLayer markers. That violates VAL-SCENE-007's requirement to reject ranges that begin or end inside unmatched markers and can also break VAL-SCENE-006's promise that balanced replay preserves scoped-layer structure. The current tests cover underflow/missing-marker cases, but not marker-free interior subranges inside an active scope.
